title: Genetic photosensitivity disorders
summary: Genetic photosensitivity disorder (xeroderma pigmentosum or other genetic photosensitivity) with documented diagnosis; xeroderma pigmentosum considered disabled per se.

children.criterion: Xeroderma pigmentosum (XP) by genetic confirmation or clinical diagnosis
Other genetic photosensitivity disorder with extensive skin lesions or substantial limitation in functioning, persisting ≥3 months despite continuing treatment
Genetic photosensitivity disorder (porphyria, EPP, Cockayne syndrome, etc.)
Extensive skin lesions OR inability to function outside a highly protective environment for at least 3 months
